raw_response: In the first iteration of the experiment, Qwen-guided planning was used to generate six candidate configurations for maximizing swimming speed while managing energy cost. All candidates met the constraints, with iter1_cand5 achieving the highest mean speed of 1.71255. Qwen's analysis highlighted that increasing frequency and stiffness could further improve speed while maintaining stability. Based on this feedback, the next strategy focuses on exploring higher frequency and stiffness values to push performance even further.
